glasgow_home_c_aileen.text: My granda worked the Clyde shipyards. The Queen Mary was launched on the Clyde in 1934, and the QE2 in 1967. He claimed he held the tea.
Stooshie is a Scots word for a fuss or an uproar. Rory's bedroom is a permanent stooshie.

glasgow_home_c_rory.text: A cooplet pinched a chip right out of my hand. They come out in the drizzle. Hold on to your chips.

then.text: Back for the Clootie Dumpling? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Mind and don't unwrap it too soon. Wait for the skin.
Flour well rubbed into the cloth so it doesn't stick. Tie it loose, it swells. Boil for hours, then into a warm oven to dry off. Fried the next morning with bacon.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
